body: Lilly was a mid-sized pharma (~$80-110 in 2018 [unverified]) behind J&J, Pfizer, Merck. Tirzepatide (dual GIP/GLP-1): SURPASS-2 (2021) beat semaglutide in diabetes; SURMOUNT-1 (Apr 2022) showed ~21-22% weight loss; Mounjaro approved May 2022, Zepbound (obesity) Nov 2023. 2024 sales: Mounjaro $11.5bn, Zepbound $4.9bn; Q3 2025 Mounjaro $6.5bn (+109%), Zepbound $3.6bn (+185%). Lilly took ~63% of US branded obesity scripts by Q3 2025 and invested tens of billions in manufacturing capacity. Nov 21 2025: first drugmaker to a $1tn market value (~$1,050+/share [unverified]) — ~10-13x from 2018; +75% since Zepbound launch vs S&P +50%; ~50x forward earnings. Split: EPS grew several-fold 2022-25 but P/E also expanded from ~20x to ~50x [approx]. Drawdown: ~-30%+ between Aug 2024 high and mid-2025 on oral-pill data and pricing worries [unverified]. EARLY SIGNAL visible 2021-22: head-to-head data beating the market leader's molecule (SURPASS-2), then SURMOUNT-1's weight-loss magnitude — public, peer-reviewed, before revenue. Who caught it: broad healthcare growth funds; no single documented investor found. Risks: price cuts under US government deals, orforglipron/oral competition, Novo/new entrants. LESSON: in category creation the winner is often the best-data fast follower with manufacturing scale, not the pioneer; head-to-head trial data is the early public signal.

data.lesson: best-data fast follower + capacity wins the category

title: Eli Lilly 2018-2025: better GLP-1 molecule, first $1tn drugmaker
